title: MSFS PC Marketplace Update – Real airline schedules JUST dropped! Winter 2025 activities
description:
MSFS Marketplace Update April 11, 2026: NEW Realistic Airline Schedules!
Looking for the latest MSFS 2020 marketplace update? This week features massive VA SYSTEMS Airline Schedules (Winter 2025) for Microsoft Flight Simulator. We explore the new MSFS activities on PC, including real-world operations for LOT, Thai Airways (THA), and Volaris (VOI) to boost your flight sim realism!

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline schedules - KAC [Winter 2025] (Realistic Kuwait Airways flight operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline schedules - LOT [Winter 2025] (Authentic LOT Polish Airlines schedules)

🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline schedules - THA [Winter 2025] (Thai Airways operational schedules)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline schedules - VOI [Winter 2025] (Volaris airline schedule set)

🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – MMMX [Winter 2025] (Mexico City Intl traffic)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – NZCH [Winter 2025] (Christchurch airport schedules)

If you enjoy flying realistic airline routes with accurate seasonal traffic, these new schedule packs are definitely worth checking out! Don’t forget to like the video if it helped, subscribe for weekly MSFS Marketplace updates, and let me know in the comments which airline or airport schedule you’ll be flying first!
